decisions.reason: We would keep the cutting and creasing finisher because it remains close to our core postpress offer, has already received dedicated market positioning, and any modest uptake can still be justified as a normal adoption process in a growing market.

We would keep the sheet preparation module because it directly supports our modular automation strategy and the investment and portfolio fit make continued commitment easier than admitting an early withdrawal.

We would keep the hybrid saddle stitcher because it extends an established booklet-making line, uses existing service and sales capabilities, and disappointing results can still be explained as temporary customer caution rather than product failure.
We would keep the folding add-on unit because it complements installed equipment, already has a visible customer reference, and the low incremental commitment needed favors persistence over exit.
